paragraph: For [Biyott Projna Tripathy](/people/biyott-projna-tripathy/), literature is an important source of stories for cinema.[^literature-outlook] She identifies her own story “ବିଦେହ (Bideha)” as the film’s source, recalling that she wrote it in 2005 or 2006 and that it appears in *Kadapana o Cleopatra*. The collection’s first edition is catalogued as published by Pakshighara Prakashanee in 2010.[^bideha-story] Her outlook invites readers and filmmakers to return to the page together: to notice a character, a voice or a question they would like to carry further.
note: [^bideha-story]: Surya Kanta Jena, [“ସାହିତ୍ୟ ଓ ସିନେମାର ଯୁଗଳବନ୍ଦୀ”](https://sambad.in/special/the-pairing-of-literature-and-cinema-11010926), *Sambad*, 19 January 2026, interview; Odisha Culture Department, [selected books, 2010–11](https://culture.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2022-06/List%20of%20Selected%20Books%20Under%20Raja%20Rammohan%20Ray%20Library%20Foundation%20%28RRRLF%29%20Scheme%20for%20the%20Year%202010-11.pdf#page=11), p. 11, entry 262.
